message: The other day, my kids had a blast pretending to be firefighters in the living room. I laughed at their enthusiasm until it hit me: we’ve never really practiced our escape plan together! So, we turned it into a fun game—setting off the smoke alarms and racing to our meeting spot outside. Turns out, it was a great way to teach them about fire safety while having a little family fun. Have you ever turned a safety lesson into a game with your kids?
